components.name: Default Button
components.description: Square white button for secondary actions on light ground.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9bacf); background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #1f2033); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--indigo, #2f3061); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2f3061); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Indigo solder-mask button for the main action in a card.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--indigo, #2f3061); background: var(--indigo, #2f3061); color: var(--silk, #fff); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--indigo-deep, #23244a); border-color: var(--indigo-deep, #23244a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo, #2f3061); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shell Button
components.description: Outlined control on the indigo shell (header, timeline).

components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { font: 13px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9bacf); background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #1f2033); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--indigo, #2f3061); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo, #2f3061); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-featured { border-color: var(--copper, #b87333); font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge { display: inline-block; margin-right: 7px; padding: 1px 6px; color: var(--copper-deep, #8a5420); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--copper, #b87333); font: 700 11px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Field

components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 15px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #565873); margin-bottom: 5px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 9px 11px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #8b8ca6); background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #1f2033); border-radius: 0; caret-color: var(--indigo, #2f3061); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo, #2f3061); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Part Option
components.description: Selectable part rows; selected takes indigo border and gold-soft fill.
components.css: .ds-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; font: 15px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-option { display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: flex-start; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdce8); padding: 9px 11px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--indigo, #2f3061); } .ds-option.ds-sel { border-color: var(--indigo, #2f3061); background: var(--gold-soft, #fff4bf); } .ds-option b { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-option small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #565873); } .ds-option input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--indigo, #2f3061); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Fixed bottom bar on indigo; the active tab is a gold pad.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; background: var(--indigo, #2f3061); border-top: 3px solid var(--copper, #b87333); } .ds-tab { flex: 1 1 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 14px 10px; font: 600 15px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--indigo-raised, #3d3e78); background: var(--indigo, #2f3061); color: var(--silk-muted, #c9cae6); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--indigo-raised, #3d3e78); color: #fff; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #ffe66d); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-tab.ds-active { color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--gold, #ffe66d); } .ds-tab-n { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border: 1.5px solid var(--copper, #b87333); } .ds-active .ds-tab-n { background: var(--gold, #ffe66d); color: var(--indigo, #2f3061); border-color: var(--gold, #ffe66d); }

components.name: Build Timeline
components.description: Signature: build steps as pads on a copper trace; done is copper, current is gold.
components.css: .ds-tl { background: var(--indigo, #2f3061); border-top: 3px solid var(--copper, #b87333); padding: 12px 14px 10px; font: 15px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tl-strip { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 2px 6px; background: linear-gradient(var(--copper, #b87333), var(--copper, #b87333)) 0 calc(50% + 2px) / 100% 2px no-repeat; } .ds-pad { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; font: 12.5px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; border: 1.5px solid var(--copper, #b87333); background: var(--indigo-deep, #23244a); color: var(--silk-muted, #c9cae6); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pad b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pad:hover { border-color: var(--gold, #ffe66d); color: #fff; } .ds-pad:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #ffe66d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pad.ds-done { background: var(--copper-deep, #8a5420); border-color: var(--copper-deep, #8a5420); color: #fff; } .ds-pad.ds-now { background: var(--gold, #ffe66d); border-color: var(--gold, #ffe66d); color: var(--indigo, #2f3061); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The app is a finished circuit board built around the student's work. The shell (header, build timeline, tab bar) is indigo solder mask carrying white silkscreen type; whatever is active or selected is a gold pad; copper is the trace that rules sections off and that the build steps travel along. Inside the shell, work happens on calm, faintly lavender-grey ground with white cards, so the breadboard drawing and the parts lists read without competition.

The density is a working tool's: compact controls, 13 to 15px text, tight 10 to 18px gaps, everything square. The palette is tinted from the logo's indigo, so neutrals are cool and faintly violet rather than flat grey. It refuses the grey SaaS page with one accent: colour carries meaning (where you are, what is done, what needs attention), not decoration.

Two drawing surfaces sit inside the world but keep their own palettes: the breadboard renderer draws a realistic white board with red and blue rails, real resistor bands and wire colours, and the schematic canvas uses conventional schematic inks. The world frames them; it never recolours them.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo solder-mask shell, white silkscreen type, copper rule along its edge.
Gold is a pad: active tab, current build step, selected option, focus on the shell.
Copper is a trace: section rules, the timeline track, done steps, featured emphasis.
Light lavender-grey work ground with white, square, thin-bordered cards.
Square corners everywhere; depth from colour and rules, not shadows.

rules.name: The Gold Pad Rule
rules.body: Gold means active or selected, nothing else. If an element is not the current tab, step, choice or focus, it is not gold.

rules.name: The Copper Trace Rule
rules.body: Featured or emphasised content uses copper, never gold. Copper is structure and emphasis; it is never body text on light ground.

rules.name: The Mint Is Retired Rule
rules.body: No mint or green tints in the UI chrome. Green exists only as schematic wire ink and in the realistic board.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Weight Rule
rules.body: On the shell, white is for the current thing and headings; secondary text drops to silk-muted, never to a lower weight or smaller size alone.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels never take drop shadows. Something floats only if it literally floats over the work (the tooltip).

dos: Do put the shell (header, timeline, tab bar) on indigo (#2f3061) with white silkscreen text and a 3px copper rule on its inner edge.
Do mark the current tab, step, selection and shell focus in gold (#ffe66d), and use gold-soft (#fff4bf) for selection on light ground.
Do use copper (#b87333) for rules, tracks, outlines and featured emphasis.
Do keep every corner square and every card border a 1px hairline.
Do let the breadboard and schematic drawings keep their own realistic colours inside the light work area.
Do keep secondary text on indigo at silk-muted (#c9cae6) and on light ground at muted (#565873) to hold contrast.
donts: Don't use gold for anything that is not active or selected; featured and emphasised content is copper.
Don't reintroduce mint or any green tint into the interface chrome.
Don't retune the logo indigo or gold.
Don't round corners on controls, cards or panels.
Don't add drop shadows to cards or panels; only the floating tooltip lifts.
Don't use copper as text colour on light ground; it is for non-text structure (copper-deep carries text).
Don't recolour the breadboard rails, resistor bands or wire colours to match the shell.
Don't introduce a display typeface until the owner approves the silkscreen font decision.
